values.value: If we started next week, how would an extract of your HubSpot estate actually be produced, who would do it — and does anyone hold the Marketing Cloud side yet?

[{"value":1,"label":"No HubSpot admin access, no owner, nobody has exported anything before \u2014 and no Marketing Cloud tenant or credentials to write to."},{"value":2,"label":"A HubSpot super admin exists; private-app tokens have not been created and would need approval. Marketing Cloud access has not been discussed."},{"value":3,"label":"A super admin can create a scoped private app this week and someone can run an operator-led extract; the Marketing Cloud installed package is provisioned or one approval away."},{"value":4,"label":"A supported connector reads the source directly with no operator in the loop."}]

No HubSpot connector ships today. The best available path is an operator-run extract against a scoped private app, which is what a 3 describes — so a 4 is not on offer for this pair, for anyone. The Marketing Cloud end is not what caps this: a server-to-server installed package is a real, obtainable credential, and a 3 assumes it.

Ask who holds HubSpot Super Admin and whether their security team permits private apps at all. Separately, ask who would create the Marketing Cloud installed package — it is frequently a different person in a different team, and that is the lead-time item.

Worth checking before you answer: who holds HubSpot Super Admin, whether your security team allows private apps at all, and who would create the Marketing Cloud installed package. That last one is often a different team.

A HubSpot-source engagement gets no automated inventory, no canonical IR generation, and no adapter-driven disposition", and infrastructure.manifest_status.adapter_status "none". docs/specs/tier-2/sfmc-target-adapter.md — the target end IS implemented, which is why this pack's anchors name it where hubspot__mcn's could not: on that pair neither end was instrumented, so its anchors are source-only and a 3 says nothing about the destination. Here a 3 has to carry both ends or it would promise a write path nobody has provisioned. The CEILING is unchanged from hubspot__mcn and unchanged in reason: capping rather than rewording the 4 keeps this comparable to a pair where a 4 IS reachable — the same scale, with a stated ceiling, rather than a different scale wearing the same numbers.
